body:
Svetyalite is an extremely rare stone, and finding it in tumbled form is even more uncommon. This limited batch was sourced from a specialized Tucson Gem Show vendor, and we hand-selected each piece before they were available to the broader market.

This stone is known for its deep emotional clearing and energetic reset. Its gentle yet profound vibration helps release stored emotions, energetic heaviness, and internal tension.

Svetyalite supports those doing deeper inner work, offering a sense of peace, lightness, and renewal. It clears your field without overwhelm, allowing healing to happen naturally and steadily.

This is a stone of restoration—helping you return to your natural state of balance and clarity.

Rare and deeply supportive, Svetyalite is a powerful companion for emotional healing and energetic renewal.
